scenes.title: Don't rip it off the wall yet
scenes.body: The reset is one hidden button and 20 seconds.

scenes.title: Find the setup button
scenes.body: Wired: under the faceplate, right side. Battery models: on the back or under the faceplate.

scenes.title: 4 steps, per Ring
items: Let go and wait a minute
Set it up again in the app

scenes.title: A reset does not remove it from your account
scenes.body: Selling or moving? Also remove the doorbell in the Ring app.

scenes.title: It may be power or Wi-Fi, not the doorbell
scenes.body: We check the transformer and signal before replacing anything.

end: Doorbell still down? We can help
